title: Python Fundamentals
summary: Learn to think in steps and express them in Python: values, control flow, functions, objects and files.

modules.title: Introduction to programming and Python
modules.summary: What programming is, and how a Python program runs.

lessons.title: What is programming?
lessons.summary: Programs are exact instructions. Learn to turn a problem into steps before touching syntax.
objectives: Break a small problem into ordered steps

lessons.title: Your first Python program
lessons.summary: Write and read a few lines of Python, and see what common mistakes look like.
objectives: Use print to display text and numbers
Recognise a SyntaxError and a NameError

modules.title: Variables and data types
modules.summary: Names, values and the basic kinds of data.

lessons.title: Variables and names
lessons.summary: A variable is a name attached to a value. Learn assignment, reassignment and the four basic types.
objectives: Name the four basic types and check one with type()
Explain why adding a string to a number fails
